limitations: Sampled source frames do not prove continuous operation between frames.
Raw ledger controls and cash-maintenance counters are not present in this public projection. Effective permission is not a private ledger pause/resume action.
Overlapping windows are not independent minutes of market coverage. No whole-market recall denominator is available.
Flat marketAt is the original USD timestamp. Held marketAt can be a liquidation/Clock minimum, so held FX age is unavailable here.
Normal RPC slot occupancy is not directly observable. MONITORING_UNAVAILABLE is not counted as a provider incident.
Trading USD values are current/historical source translations as labeled; different-time trade values are not subtracted as exact realized USD profit.

criteria.continuousOperation: Requires corroborating source/feed/protection/reporting and EC2 evidence; sampled uptime alone is insufficient.
